title: Query commands use issue compaction
description: When a CLI feature queries for issue information, return the most-recent summary comment if one exists instead of raw data.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text:
Feature: Issue querying uses compaction
  Scenario: Querying an issue with a summary
    Given an issue with a comment of type "summary"
    When I query the issue via CLI commands (e.g. kbs show or kbs list)
    Then the system returns the data from the most-recent summary comment
    And it does not try to return the original raw data
